plots.title: 2. Detect IQR outliers in key numeric columns
plots.insight: **Insight.** IQR flags unusually large homes, lots, and prices. These are plausible market observations, so the pipeline retains them and reduces their influence with robust scaling and a log target.

plots.title: 2. Visualize the price distribution before and after log transformation
plots.insight: **Insight.** The log transformation reduces the long high-price tail. Models use log price, then return predictions to the original price scale for evaluation.

plots.title: 2. Plot the price boxplot
plots.insight: **Insight.** The long upper tail represents valid luxury sales. Removing them would make the model less useful for the complete market.

plots.title: 2. Plot living-area features against price
plots.insight: **Insight.** Living area should show a strong positive relationship with price. Total living area is used as the primary size feature.

plots.title: 2. Compare category features with price
plots.insight: **Insight.** Grade, view, and waterfront status can separate price levels. Bedrooms are useful, but total area and quality provide more complete information.

plots.title: 2. Plot the correlation heatmap
plots.insight: **Insight.** The heatmap identifies useful price relationships and redundant size variables. It supports the later correlation and VIF feature-selection step.

plots.title: 2. Plot numeric feature histograms
plots.insight: **Insight.** Several size variables are right-skewed. RobustScaler uses medians and interquartile ranges, so it is less affected by extreme values.

plots.title: 2. Map home prices by latitude and longitude
plots.insight: **Insight.** Price clusters geographically, which supports using location as a model input. Zip code is encoded categorically rather than treated as an ordered number.

plots.title: 2. Compare average price by zip code, year built, and sale month
plots.insight: **Insight.** Location is strongly associated with average price. Year-built and sale-month patterns are descriptive, not proof of causal effects.

plots.title: 10. Plot actual versus predicted values and residuals
plots.insight: **Insight.** Points close to the diagonal represent accurate predictions. Residuals should be centered around zero; wider spread at high prices is common for rare luxury homes.

plots.title: 10. Plot feature importance for the best model
plots.insight: **Insight.** The feature-importance ranking is a model-based check on the EDA. Important area, grade, and location inputs support the earlier findings.
